_provenance: Authoritative drug-safety rules TRANSCRIBED from published criteria — each rule cites its source. This is a curated subset (not a full DB dump): the bulk machine-readable DBs (DDInter drug-drug; RxSafeBench RxRisk) were not reachable programmatically. To expand: drop a downloaded DDInter / RxRisk CSV into data/rules/ and extend the loader. Sources: AGS Beers Criteria 2023 (J Am Geriatr Soc, doi:10.1111/jgs.18372); STOPP/START v3 (Eur Geriatr Med 2023, doi:10.1007/s41999-023-00777-y); FDA prescribing labels; KDIGO. NOT authored from our own medical judgment.
_schema: kind=drug_lab|drug_condition|drug_drug; drug/partner/condition are lowercase substring match terms; severity=contraindicated|avoid|major|caution
